fomod.Name: OSF Animation Browser
fomod.Author: ozooma10
fomod.Description: Optional in-game animation browser and emote wheel. Requires matching OSF Animation 1.5.0, OSF UI 2.0.0+, and OSF Settings 1.0.0+. Includes its own native DLL and optional vanilla/creature library and emote content. Install alongside the engine, replace any old Browser installation, and rebind both browser hotkeys after upgrading from the combined settings provider.
